description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice for Market Research. Please review the attached sources sought in its entirety. The Defense Threat Reduction Agency is seeking firms with capabilities to provide services to operate the Defense Threat Reduction Information Analysis Center located at Kirtland AFB, NM. Note that DTRIAC is not an IAC under the Defense Technical Information Center.

Amendment 1 to this Sources Sought is posted, 4 Mar 26, to revise the requirement to use Helvetica font.  Please see the Sources Sought for full text.
